batuku.quote: O Batuque (Batuku ou Batuk em crioulo cabo-verdiano) é um género musical, um património cultural e um género de dança de Cabo Verde.
it is the only genre that is polyrhythmic
it is a 3-beat rhythm over a 2-beat rhythm
executes a polyrhythmic hit, while the others execute a 2-beat hit, clapping hands or slapping a cloth
marcado pela percussão das 'tchabetas e palmas'
batuku.note: Margarida Brito (1998), Breves Apontamentos sobre as Formas Musicais existentes em Cabo Verde, PDF.

batuku.quote: a group of performers (almost always just women) gather themselves in a circle
sings a verse that is immediately repeated (called ronca baxon
improvised proverbs that talk about a variety of subjects such as praising personalities, social criticism, quotidian scenes, are called finason
O Finaçon é uma melopeia que consiste num encadeamento de provérbios
batuku.note: Continues: declaimed in the batuque rhythm, almost always improvised, normally sung by a woman.

batuku.quote: The second movement is called txabéta
is made with a hip swing managed through the quick flexion of the knees
The music leans on a polyphonic support (chord sequences)
O Batuque, de origem africana, que surge em Cabo Verde provavelmente só na ilha
Seria a adaptação de alguma dança africana
A mais antiga referência encontrada é uma proibição datada de setembro de 1772
there are written records of it only from the 19th century
batuku.note: Disagrees with the Portuguese article (1772); see notes (c).

batuku.quote: A Santiago batuque featured in the first issue of Claridade issued in 1936
Presently, it is found only in Santiago, notably Tarrafal
é na vila de Tarrafal onde se vive com mais intensidade este género musical
The batuque has even been forbidden in urban centers and it was a dying musical genre from the 1950s.
It was in the nineties that the batuque experienced a true rebirth with young composers
até ser reconhecido como Património Cultural e Imaterial (PCI) Cabo-verdiano
Morna, musical practice of Cabo Verde (2019, RL)
batuku.note: The only Cabo Verde element on the UNESCO lists page; batuku is not inscribed.

batuku.quote: na Expo 92, em Sevilha, Espanha, no Festival of American Folklife, da Smithsonian Institution, em Washington DC, em 1995
